content: Ligand 1 here is the same pyrazolyl-acetamide/tetrahydroisoquinoline scaffold I worked on earlier, and ligand 2 (jnk3~0.03) is a tetrahydropyran-oxadiazole with SA 3.60 - a strained, low-accessibility piece I do not want to carry over, so no crossover. I will reuse the identical anchor on ligand 1 (cut the non-ring CH2-N bond 16-17 to drop the tetrahydroisoquinoline) but graft a different hinge binder this time: 7-azaindol-3-yl (1H-pyrrolo[2,3-b]pyridin-3-yl). Putting a second chemotype on the same host at the same position makes this a controlled test of which hinge binder this target actually recognizes, rather than a confounded change of both scaffold and motif. Azaindole also brings a donor NH plus pyridine-type acceptor, and keeps MW near 345.
